description: This PHP source file defines a class CalendarViewJson that extends SugarView, used to output JSON data for calendar views in SuiteCRM. It includes a display method that outputs JSON-encoded data passed via the view_object_map.

classes.name: CalendarViewJson
classes.description: A class extending SugarView that outputs JSON data for calendar views.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Outputs JSON data stored in view_object_map['jsonData'] if it exists; otherwise logs a fatal error and performs cleanup.
